description: This file implements validation logic for fragment shader outputs in a graphics shader compiler, checking for conflicts, range issues, and YUV output validity.

classes.name: ValidateOutputsTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses shader output symbols to validate their correctness and consistency.

methods.name: ValidateOutputsTraverser::visitSymbol
methods.description: Visits a symbol node in the shader's intermediate representation to categorize and record output symbols.

methods.name: ValidateOutputsTraverser::validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the collected output symbols, reporting conflicts and range errors.

methods.name: ValidateOutputs
methods.description: Main function that initiates validation of shader outputs within the AST root node.
